speaker: Kronii
message:
Anyways it was super nice seeing you guys! Thanks for stopping by!
I'll try and have next week's schedule up by the end of today.
I'm thinking tomorrow I'll do some superchat reading, hopefully
I can get through all the superchats from the last 3000 years.
Shouldn't take too long... hopefully.

speaker: Chat
message:
Isn't tomorrow your birthday?
Are you going to do anything special?

speaker: Kronii
message:
Birthday? Oh, crap. I almost forgot.
I guess being the warden of time does that to you sometimes.
Hmm.. Maybe I'll do a birthday zatsu, or sit in VC
and wait for call-ins.

speaker: Chat
message:
Call-ins? Who's gonna call?
You're the last member of Hololive.

speaker: Kronii
message:
Last member of Hololive?! What? No! That's ridiculous!
I'll just call Irys, she's always down for call-in.
... Huh? She graduated 300,000 years ago to save humanity?
Oh... right, I remember now.
What about Florpus Melodica from Hololive Outer-Space?
She got sucked into a black hole? Ah, yeah, that too.
Well then, what about Bae?!
... She's Australian? You're right.
Dang, am I really the only one left?
One million years already...
I really need to touch some grass.
Sorry guys, the schedule might be delayed.
Anyways, Kroyasumii everyone! I'll see you next time.
